title: silene coeli-rosa var. subaspera
intro: Silene coeli-rosa var. subaspera, commonly known as a type of catchfly, is a plant species in the Caryophyllaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Silene coeli-rosa var. subaspera are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
